title: Drone Circuit
pitch: Pilot a tiny drone through ordered gates while viewing it from a stable trackside position or desktop chase camera.
rules: Bounded arcade flight controls; no aerodynamic claim. Gates must be crossed in sequence and correct direction.
A reset returns to the last valid gate with a time penalty. Best-run ghost is non-colliding recorded presentation.
XR baseline is trackside remote piloting; a camera strapped to the moving drone is not required.
content: Three compact courses, training mode and bronze/silver/gold targets.

actions.desktop: WASD, rise/fall keys, mouse yaw optional
actions.phone: Two thumb controls with explicit rise/fall buttons
actions.xr: Controller stick or world-panel pads; target-ray selection for menus
Choose fixed spectator pedestal; no forced chase

rive.role: Telemetry card and animated mechanic, as a spatial panel in XR.

polish: Stable XR horizon and selectable spectator positions
tests: Passing behind/out of order cannot score a gate.
Phone simultaneous controls retain pointer ownership.
XR entry preserves drone velocity but starts paused until Resume.
Large frame stall clamps catch-up and reports pause rather than teleporting through course.
loop: sample flight intent and clamp axes
advance game kinematics at fixed tick
sweep movement against gates and simple obstacles
project drone animation, audio and telemetry
save: Exact logical flight state; loading resumes paused at saved pose. Persistent ghosts capped by duration/sample count.
xr_presentation: Immersive VR track viewed from a stationary spectator position with remote drone control; optional AR mini-course is a later explicit extension.
comfort: No compulsory first-person flight. Spectator relocation uses instant teleport/fade, never a forced camera ride.
documentKind: Exact logical flight state; loading resumes paused at saved pose. Persistent ghosts capped by duration/sample count.
